mike: Quick weekly GPU demand pass — noticed an uptick in inference requests tied to the new recommendations rollout. Dropping a compact view, please flag anything that looks off.

mike: ```
region  | cluster    | projected GPU-hrs wk | delta
US-W    | uw-prod-1  | 18,200               | +8%
US-E    | ue-prod-2  | 9,400                | +2%
EU-W    | ew-batch   | 4,800                | +12% (night)
AP-S    | ap-prod    | 3,200                | +25% (promo)
Total   |            | 35,600               | +9% vs last wk
```

asha: Noted. EU-West has infra maintenance Fri 02:00-06:00 UTC, can we push the batch earlier? :thinking:

lina: @asha I can shift EW batch window to 22:00-02:00 UTC but that will increase AP-S spot usage. Is that acceptable?

sam: Quick cost sanity: moving EW batch earlier shifts ~900 GPU-hrs to AP-S nights -> roughly $8.5k/week incremental. Need finance sign-off before we commit to longer runs.

capacity-bot: Autoscaler suggestion: increase ap-prod target from 6 -> 8 cards during promo window (03/19-03/26). Expected burn +18%, latency risk reduced.

mike: Proposed decision: 1) apply autoscaler bump for AP-S during promo window, 2) move EU-W batch earlier to avoid maintenance window, 3) throttle low-priority retrains during peak. @lina @asha please own changes.

lina: Will update cron and bump batch start to 22:00 UTC. I'll also add a short staging warmup to reduce cache churn.

asha: I'll update the maintenance page and add an entry to the ops schedule. Will also prepare a rollback checklist if AP-S saturates.

sam: I'll open the finance ticket and share the updated delta in #finance. If they push back we can revert the autoscaler tweak.

mike: Follow-ups: 
- lina: commit batch shift by EOD Thursday
- asha: publish rollback runbook + circuit breaker thresholds
- sam: confirm finance by Friday noon :thumbsup:

mike: Attaching a short log snippet showing yesterday's tail latency spike for context:

mike: ```
[2026-03-16T23:42Z] uw-prod-1 tail90: 480ms -> 820ms during 30m window
requests: spike from 120rps -> 260rps
KV cache hit: 72% -> 56%
```

lina: That aligns with cache churn from the rollout. I'll add a warmup step to the next deploy to mitigate.

capacity-bot: Scheduled scaling test: 2026-03-18 01:00 UTC to validate autoscaler changes. Will post results.

mike: If no objections by EOD we roll tomorrow morning. Thanks all.
